Every model in this category carries the same note: cross-border data review is advised, which means the compliance question is not vendor-specific but jurisdictional, applying uniformly across all seven entries.

The vendors span some of China's largest technology companies, including ByteDance, Baidu, Tencent, Alibaba Cloud, and Xiaomi, alongside independent AI firms Zhipu AI and MiniMax. The breadth of that list suggests foundation model development in China is not concentrated in a single actor but distributed across both platform giants and specialized builders. What the data does not say is anything about model architecture, parameter counts, benchmark performance, or the compute infrastructure behind any of these systems, so no comparison of capability or scale is possible from this source alone.

For organizations evaluating these models, the consistent cross-border advisory is the operationally significant detail. It points toward data-handling and regulatory due diligence as a prerequisite, regardless of which vendor or model is under consideration. The data covers seven models as of September 2026 and does not indicate whether the list is exhaustive of Chinese foundation models available at that date.
